findings.title: Gateway's listeners do not admit the route
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop attaches to Gateway public, and no listener it attaches to admits it, so the Gateway serves none of its requests: listener http admits routes from namespaces labelled gateway-access=public only (allowedRoutes.namespaces.from: Selector), and namespace kd-gateway-namespace-not-allowed has labels kubernetes.io/metadata.name=kd-gateway-namespace-not-allowed

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-namespace-not-allowed -o jsonpath='{.spec.parentRefs}'

evidence.what: Gateway public's listeners and the routes they allow
evidence.command: kubectl get gateway public -n kd-gateway-namespace-not-allowed -o jsonpath='{.spec.listeners}'

findings.fix: Label namespace kd-gateway-namespace-not-allowed so listener http's selector matches it, or correct the selector on Gateway public.
